used_titles: The Door That Opens to Tomorrow
used_premises: A door shows him one moment from tomorrow
A snow globe shows a sunny memory whenever he feels alone.
He lends his umbrella to a stranger and later gets it back with a note.
A bottle on his rooftop contains a wish written ten years earlier.
He gives his last coin to a stranger, who leaves him a mysterious map.
An unused train ticket leads him to a person waiting for an apology.
He plans a birthday surprise for a neighbour who thinks everyone forgot.

films.title: The Door That Opens to Tomorrow
